The '''Giant Pit''' is a small enclosure found north-west of [[Shayzien]]. Occupied by 13 [[Hill Giant]]s, the pit is guarded by three [[Soldier (Shayzien)|soldiers]] and their [[Sergeant (Shayzien)|sergeant]]. A jetty can be found just west where players can board the [[boaty]] to [[Molch]], [[Lake Molch]], or the [[Battlefront]].

Just south-west of the pit is a cave entrance that leads to the [[Giants' Den]], which is inhabited by more dangerous giants that have been corrupted by the power of the [[Dark Altar]]. Immediately south of the den is the [[Secluded Chapel]].

An easy way to travel to the Giant Pit is to use [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|DJR}} and run south; or travel to History and Hearsay via the [[Kharedst's memoirs]] or the [[Book of the Dead]] and run north then west.
